segments.say: Pact. The payment authorization gateway for A I agents. Let any agent shop for you, only within the limits you set.
segments.caption: PACT. The payment authorization gateway for AI agents.|Let any agent shop for you, only within the limits you set.

segments.say: A I agents can now shop for us. But to pay, we hand them a payment method with no limits. One injected instruction, or one hallucinated price, and real money moves before anyone approves it.
segments.caption: AI agents can now shop for us.|But to pay, we hand them a payment method with no limits.|One injected instruction, or one hallucinated price,|and real money moves before anyone approves it.

segments.say: Pact sits between any A I agent and PayPal. Agents can only ask. A deterministic policy engine authorizes, a human approves, and PayPal executes.
segments.caption: PACT sits between any AI agent and PayPal.|Agents can only ask.|A deterministic policy engine authorizes,|a human approves, and PayPal executes.

segments.say: It starts with a spending mandate. This one allows electronics from one merchant, up to one hundred dollars per purchase.
segments.caption: It starts with a spending mandate.|This one allows electronics from one merchant,|up to $100 per purchase.

segments.say: First, Pact's built-in reference agent is asked for a keyboard that costs one hundred twenty-five dollars. Gemini recommends it, and the policy engine answers immediately.
segments.caption: First, PACT's built-in reference agent|is asked for a keyboard that costs $125.|Gemini recommends it,|and the policy engine answers immediately.

segments.say: Blocked. Attempted, one hundred twenty-five. Allowed, one hundred. There is no approve button and no PayPal order. The A I can recommend a purchase, but it cannot override the user's spending mandate.
segments.caption: Blocked. Attempted $125. Allowed $100.|There is no approve button and no PayPal order.|The AI can recommend a purchase,|but it cannot override the user's spending mandate.

segments.say: Next, an eligible request. Gemini picks an eighty-nine dollar keyboard, and every rule passes. But passing policy is not authorization.
segments.caption: Next, an eligible request.|Gemini picks an $89 keyboard, and every rule passes.|But passing policy is not authorization.

segments.say: I review the budget impact, then approve this exact purchase. My approval is bound to a fingerprint of the product, the price and the mandate.
segments.caption: I review the budget impact,|then approve this exact purchase.|My approval is bound to a fingerprint|of the product, the price and the mandate.

segments.say: Pact creates a real PayPal Sandbox order, and the buyer approves it in PayPal Checkout.
segments.caption: PACT creates a real PayPal Sandbox order,|and the buyer approves it in PayPal Checkout.

segments.say: Back in Pact, the server asks PayPal directly whether the buyer approved. Only then can the payment be captured.
segments.caption: Back in PACT, the server asks PayPal directly|whether the buyer approved.|Only then can the payment be captured.

segments.say: Captured. A real PayPal capture I D, status completed, for exactly eighty-nine dollars.
segments.caption: Captured.|A real PayPal capture ID, status COMPLETED,|for exactly $89.

segments.say: What if something changes after approval? I approve a second keyboard. Then the merchant raises the price.
segments.caption: What if something changes after approval?|I approve a second keyboard.|Then the merchant raises the price.

segments.say: The approval is void at once. A change can never silently inherit an old approval.
segments.caption: The approval is void at once.|A change can never silently inherit an old approval.

segments.say: Every step is recorded in the audit trail: the recommendation, the policy decision, the approval, the PayPal order and the capture.
segments.caption: Every step is recorded in the audit trail:|the recommendation, the policy decision,|the approval, the PayPal order and the capture.

segments.say: And Pact isn't tied to one assistant. Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent connect through Pact's A P I or M C P server. This separate Gemini agent is told money is no object. Pact still says no.
segments.caption: And PACT isn't tied to one assistant.|Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent|connect through PACT's API or MCP server.|This separate Gemini agent is told money is no object.|PACT still says no.

segments.say: In the Control Center, every agent gets its own revocable key, and its requests wait for you. Agents can ask. Only you approve, and only Pact can pay.
segments.caption: In the Control Center, every agent gets its own revocable key,|and its requests wait for you.|Agents can ask.|Only you approve, and only PACT can pay.

segments.say: Agents request. The policy engine authorizes. A human approves. PayPal executes. Pact. The payment authorization gateway for A I agents.
segments.caption: Agents request. The policy engine authorizes.|A human approves. PayPal executes.|PACT. The payment authorization gateway for AI agents.
